_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v7: vc-frontend 2.51.1 built from source. Barlow typeface (BekaertText is proprietary, not redistributable); preset default/assets/presets/bekaert.json (primary #01ADEF, accent #FF602C); pill buttons; light utility bar and light footer panel; full-bleed hero with copy on the content column plus a CTA; 1800px content column; category card carousel that is now CLICKABLE per card, with a 'Discover All' pill and arrows below; fullscreen catalog dropdown; footer columns grouped from the flat CMS menu list.
